title: Sketch
desc: Sketch works under a loan shark who takes the vehicles of those who are unable to pay him back. However, one such defaulter is a deadly gangster who turns livid when he finds that his car is taken.

title: Dr. Saleem
desc: Salim, a dedicated doctor, goes lawless and violent to bring justice to society.

title: Amaran
desc: Major Mukund Varadarajan, a commissioned officer in the Rajput Regiment of the Indian Army, conducts a counterterrorism operation while being deployed to Jammu and Kashmir.

title: Mrithyunjay
desc: An aspiring crime reporter becomes suspicious when a death is ruled as accidental. Soon, when he investigates, he encounters a complex web of deception and danger.

title: Daaku Maharaaj
desc: A brave thief fights to survive and claim his territory. However, he battles powerful enemies, aiming to become a leader without a real kingdom.

title: Bheema
desc: Sekar admires Chinna and teams up with him to take over the streets of Chennai. However, things change drastically when Sekar falls in love and decides to change his ways.

title: Pandavulu Pandavulu Thummeda
desc: Two ex-lovers are reunited by a young girl, Honey. When everything falls into place and the adopted children of the lovers agree to their union, Honey gets kidnapped.

title: Dhada
desc: An engineer falls in love with the daughter of a businessman. However, he gets embroiled in the affairs of a human trafficking gang while his lover's marriage is fixed elsewhere.

title: Om
desc: After thwarting the enemy's plans to kill his father Harishchandra, Arjun learns a shocking truth that turns his life upside-down.

title: Guruvayur Ambalanadayil
desc: A young man eagerly awaits his wedding, but fate twists cruelly, forcing him into a lifelong bond with a woman who harbours nothing but resentment for him.

title: Nuvvu Naaku Nachav
desc: Venky, an unemployed youth, heads to Hyderabad for a marriage ceremony. What seems like a brief vacation gradually turns into something more, when the soon-to-be bride falls for him.

title: Tenali Ramakrishna BA.BL
desc: A money-driven lawyer takes on cases based on their profitability. However, he has a change of heart when he is assigned a criminal case and decides to fight for justice.

title: The Family Star
desc: Govardhan, a diligent architect, longs for a partner who understands his commitment to his large family. When Indu, a new tenant, moves in, his life starts to unfold in a new direction.

title: Mirchi
desc: Manasa falls in love with Jai after he helps her and manages to win the hearts of her family with his good deeds. However, she is unaware that he belongs to a rival family.
